C0779.title: Lanzhou University Server Compromised by Remote Cryptomining Malware with Lateral Spread
C0779.summary: In May 2026, a university in Lanzhou discovered that its server had been remotely implanted with cryptomining malware, which then spread laterally to other office devices.
